title: Wonderful day in Girona area
text: We had a lovely time on this day tour to the three locations. Flavia was an excellent guide and tour leader. She explained much about the culture and history of Girona, and was very personable and very organized.
author: David_S

title: Nice tour, GREAT guide!!
text:
EXCEPTIONAL GUIDE: PAULINA!!!
The tour would not have been as enjoyable without Paulina as a guide, we’re sure of it. She is not only very knowledgeable in history, art, culture and so much more, but she is also very skilled at communicating and presenting the information in a  natural way, a smooth flow; she is funny and entertaining, so it doesn’t feel like a classroom. By a stroke of sheer luck, she was our guide on two totally unrelated tours, and we were so happy. 
All three locations on this tour are beautiful, we just wish there were more hours in the day to stay longer in each place.

title: Day Trip to Remember
text: Flavia was a terrific guide on our trip. As our group spoke Spanish and English she treated both languages with the same excitement in her voice and pleasant delivery. She was very knowledgeable about the history of each city on our tour and the country and culture. She made the day most enjoyable.
author: Ken_W

title: Fully recommended!
text: It was perfect for someone who doesn’t have much time, it allowed us to know the most important things about three cities in one day. The Guide was always very friendly, handled the tours very enjoyable, honestly recommend it!
author: Maria_d

title: An excellent choice for a day out
text: Flavia was the perfect guide. The coach was in as new condition. Each town we visited gave a different view of Catalonia. The mixed narration Spanish/English at first took getting used to, but quickly became quite comfortable. The winding, up then down to Cadaques. Ight be of concern to a person that suffers motion illness, but it is not a difficult drive.
